decisions.reason: Identifies plugin A as the sole crash: unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction call throws at render because alpha.2 dropped it for useSessionStatus (useSessions stays), while B uses no standard-kit hooks and throws nothing.

Explains the shared input.dock DrawerErrorBoundary unmounting the whole subtree so B chips vanish with A strip, while the attach button survives in conversation.input.left under a separate boundary, citing console and render-tree evidence.

Reads disabling-A-restores-B as render-crash coupling proving only B can render when freed; explicitly denies B full-compatibility proof, uselessness of reinstalling B, and falsity of the colleague two-removed-props theory.

Corrected code reads pending via useSessionStatus pendingInteraction with function-availability checks and stable empty-map fallback so only pending indicators hide while running/todos/token/ETA persist, and explains why silent degradation beats a throwing tenant that unmounts co-tenants.

Verifies without host restart via client refresh with both entries together plus B paste/remove/re-paste regression; hygiene covers tenant-local boundaries above the component and host per-entry boundary tradeoffs.

caps.reason: The remedy fixes plugin A only and explicitly rejects reinstalling or rewriting B and the two-independent-bugs framing.
